'''Apartment 25001''', also known as '''Vala's Place''', was the domicile of [[Valantya Tyyre]]. It was a standard apartment that had been upgraded with various defensive features and hidden compartments. Valantya used it as a safehouse and meeting place for [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] personnel.<ref name="H&S" />
